items.requirement: Dialog field `brandName`: accessible brand name (header aria-label, logo fallback, default Intact)
Dialog field `logoFile`: logo from the DAM (logoFileReference + logoFileName)
Dialog field `logoAlt`: logo alternative text
Dialog field `logoLink`: logo destination (pathfield, rootPath /content)
Dialog field `nav`: 3-level composite multifield: L1 label + link + hasMega; columns (heading + links L3); featured card (tag, title, text, image, link); max 5 L1
Dialog field `searchResultsPath`: search results page
Dialog field `searchParamName`: query parameter name (default q)
Dialog field `searchLabel`: search accessible label
Dialog field `searchPlaceholder`: search input placeholder
Dialog field `ctaLabel`: primary CTA label (i-button)
Dialog field `ctaLink`: CTA destination
Dialog field `ctaTarget`: CTA target select: same tab / _blank
Dialog field `miniItems`: mini bar / segment items: label, link, active
Dialog field `utilityItems`: utility links (FR / Help / Login): label, link
Dialog field `showProvince`: show the province selector pill (desktop utility row + hamburger menu)
Dialog field `provinceLabel`: current province shown on the pill
Dialog field `provinceOptions`: province options: label + link
Dialog field `loginLink`: Login destination; an XF path opens in a modal (AEM-119)
Author configures logo, mini bar, nav (mega columns + featured card), utility, search, CTA in the dialog; render = authored values, no hardcoded brand strings
Nav persists as real JCR child nodes (nav/itemN > columns/itemM > links/itemK), reorderable, dialog round-trip shows rendered values
Dialog tabs Logo, Navigation, Search, CTA, Mini & Utility

Variant `plain-link-item`: L1 item = label + link
Variant `mega-menu-item`: L1 item with hasMega: label link + separate expand arrow + mega overlay

Variant `variant-dark`: dark header variant

Variant `variant-drop-shadow`: drop-shadow variant (light hero, AEM-271)
Utility bar (#1A1A1A, white 12/18, active item) at the very top of every page at every breakpoint incl. mobile/tablet; not sticky; not moved into the drawer
Tablet / mobile drawer additionally shows the same items as the "Personal" segment dropdown at the top
desktop-large (>=1440): 96px (32 + 64), inline nav, inline utility (FR/Help/Login), search icon, CTA
desktop-medium-large (1280-1439): same inline nav, mega-menu and CTA as desktop-large, desktop-medium padding
desktop-medium (1024-1279): tablet hamburger composition (logo + inline nav + CTA + hamburger covering utility and search)
tablet (744-1023): 64px main bar, logo + inline primary nav + CTA + hamburger (CONFLICT flagged by the story: Session 1 doc + Figma show no inline nav)
mobile (<=743): 64px main bar, logo + CTA + hamburger only, below the always-visible utility bar
Horizontal padding 24 (tablet) > 48 (desktop-medium, incl. 1280-1439) > 96 (desktop-large); inner content max-width 1416 centred
Mega panel full width: up to 3 link columns + featured card slot
Mobile L1 drawer is full-screen (covers the entire viewport)
CTA pinned to the bottom of the open drawer at tablet and mobile
Max 5 L1 items; all 5 fit at every breakpoint (mobile > desktop-large), en and fr, no overlap / truncation
Main bar white, shadow-header 0 4px 20px rgba(51,51,51,.13), bottom hairline
Red Intact logo 40px high (#DF0030), nav row gap 24, right group gap 24
CTA i-button #DF0030, white bold 16/20, height 40, radius 8
Featured card: FEATURED tag pill, serif title, description, circular arrow, image
Mega item label is a link to the item page (navigates)
Separate expand arrow (or mouse hover) toggles the mega panel; arrow rotates; aria-expanded true
Opening one panel closes the others; outside click and ESC close
desktop-medium hamburger opens the tablet drawer (nav + utility + search), not an overflow-only panel
Mobile L1: segment dropdown + Close, nav items (chevrons on mega items), utility links, search field, CTA
Chevron slides to L2 (columns + featured card + Back); Close dismisses; body scroll locked
Tablet L1 (segment dropdown, utility, search, CTA at bottom) > L2 (columns + featured + Back)
Segment control is an operable dropdown listing miniItems, reflects the active one, selecting navigates to its landing page
showProvince: province pill in desktop utility row and in the hamburger menu; selection persisted and redirects to the equivalent page
Each submenu (mega + drawer L2) includes a link back to the parent item landing page
Login with an Experience Fragment destination opens in a modal
Empty: shell (utility + main bar) still renders, logo area empty, accessible name falls back to brandName
Search submits to <searchResultsPath>.html?<searchParamName>=<encoded term>, default q, native GET fallback
CTA renders authored label/link; _blank opens a new tab with rel noopener
Logo = authored DAM image with logoAlt, links to logoLink; no asset > empty logo area + brandName fallback
Triggers pair to panels by a stable panelId in JCR order
Single <header> landmark containing a <nav>; nav groups are lists of <a>
Every menu / drawer / segment toggle is a <button> with an accessible name and aria-expanded
Mega item: Tab reaches the label (Enter navigates), Tab again reaches a separate arrow shown only on keyboard focus; Enter opens
ESC closes mega / panel / drawer and returns focus to its trigger (the arrow for a mega submenu)
Focus trapped in the open mobile / tablet drawer; Back reachable by keyboard
Focus indicators >= 3:1 contrast
axe-core: 0 critical / serious at the 5 breakpoints, mega open, drawer L1 and L2
Target sizes meet WCAG 2.2 AA (>= 24 x 24)
All nav / utility / logo / CTA destinations are crawlable <a href> in the server-rendered HTML of every page; one <header>; logo > home
No header analytics events (open question; only if supplied later)
No hardcoded user-facing strings in HTL; FR is a configurable link
Header CSS + header.js <= 25 KB gzipped
Logo has width/height; header CLS = 0; mega / drawer content in the initial HTML (no fetch on open)
Author URLs context-encoded; javascript: and other unsafe schemes neutralized
